item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Monday 16 February In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Monday, 16 February - politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: IND vs PAK Highlights: India thrash Pakistan by 61 runs in T20 World Cup clash; Record broken
item.description: India delivered a commanding performance against Pakistan in the T20 World Cup, securing a historic 61-run victory. Ishan Kishan’s explosive half-century powered India to a strong total before disciplined bowling dismantled Pakistan’s batting lineup.

item.title: PM Modi to inaugurate India AI Impact Expo 2026; Global tech leaders unite at five-day Summit
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the India AI Impact Expo 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, bringing together global technology firms, startups, policymakers, and researchers.

item.title: West Bengal: Election Commission takes major action, 7 Officials suspended over voter list irregularities
item.description: India’s Election Commission has suspended seven officials in West Bengal over alleged irregularities in voter list revision, ordering immediate disciplinary action.

item.title: Profit booking drags Gold lower, Silver sees sharp fall in morning trade; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices fell nearly 1% on MCX due to profit booking after the previous session’s rally, while silver dropped around 3% following US CPI data and a stronger dollar index.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower as weak sentiment persists in early trade; Click for details
item.description: Indian equity markets opened lower on Monday following last week’s sharp decline, with benchmark indices slipping in early trade. Persistent selling in technology stocks and uncertainty around artificial intelligence-driven disruption continue to pressure investor sentiment.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Pakistan’s TV-breaking reactions return following loss to India; Video viral
item.description: India’s emphatic 61-run victory over Pakistan in the T20 World Cup triggered emotional reactions among Pakistani fans, with videos of supporters smashing televisions going viral online.

item.title: AI Impact Summit: PM Modi showcases India’s science and tech achievements; Details here
item.description: Ahead of the AI Impact Summit, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India’s rapid advances in science, technology, and digital infrastructure position the country at the forefront of global artificial intelligence transformation.

item.title: Assam Rifles strikes big against drug trafficking, Yaba tablets worth Rs 45 Cr seized
item.description: In a major anti-narcotics operation in Tripura, Assam Rifles and the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized around 4.5 lakh Yaba tablets valued at ₹45 crore. One individual was arrested and handed over to DRI for investigation.

item.title: Bhiwadi Industrial Horror: Chemical factory catches fire; Seven dead, several injured
item.description: A devastating fire broke out in a chemical factory in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, killing seven workers and injuring several others. The blaze, suspected to have started due to short-circuit or flammable materials, caused widespread panic in the industrial area.
